name: Ponder
tagline: Notes, notebooks and a web clipper, with AI and MCP
description: Self-hosted knowledge base: nested notebooks, rich text and Markdown, tables, diagrams, attachments, full-text search, sharing and an MCP server. Based on EdgeEver (github.com/tianma-if/edgeever). Free software under the AGPL-3.0: the complete source is at github.com/nattygirma/ponder.

features.title: Pages that hold everything
features.body: Write with headings, to-do lists, callouts, images, columns and tables. Nest pages inside pages and keep each project in one place.

features.title: Databases and boards
features.body: Track projects, reading lists or anything else with status, tags, dates and numbers. View the same data as a table, a board or a calendar.

features.title: Type / for any block
features.body: Press / and pick what you need: a heading, a to-do list, a table, a chart or a full database. No toolbars to hunt through.

features.title: AI that reads your notes
features.body: Ask about the page you're on to get a summary, the decisions or the action items. It works without an API key of your own, paid from your AppKeep balance.

features.title: Easy move from Notion
features.body: Export your Notion workspace as Markdown & CSV and import the zip. Your pages, nesting and databases come across.

features.title: Web clipper and AI agents
features.body: Save articles from the web with the browser clipper, and let AI tools like Claude read and update your notes through Ponder's built-in MCP server.
